remarks: Welcome to 1,226 square feet of upgraded living in the heart of Downtown Stamford. This 2 bed, 2 full bath condo offers a thoughtful layout and modern finishes throughout.  The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops and flows into an open living area that leads to a covered balcony overlooking the gazebo garden-perfect for a morning coffee or evening unwind.  Both bedrooms are oversized, each with a walk-in closet for plenty of storage. The primary suite includes its own full bath, and in-unit laundry adds everyday convenience.  This unit includes 2 reserved spaces in the underground garage-an uncommon perk in the area.  Residents enjoy access to great building amenities: a fitness center, Amazon package locker, and outdoor grilling area.  Just 4 minutes to I-95, the Stamford Train Station, Bedford Street's top restaurants and bars, and Landmark Square-this location makes it easy to enjoy all that Stamford has to offer.
